cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a Three Kingdoms festival street — standing; a contemporary private overnight ferry cabin with a round window — she sits back after reaching for a folded blank timetable; a starship data archive — sets a cup down on the surface in front of her; a modern glass-walled office at dusk — sketches in a sketchbook and pencil; a hangar maintenance bay — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver; a walled garden with a lotus pond — standing; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a quiet modern seaside guesthouse bedroom with pale blue walls — she laughs softly at the distant cry of a gull while sitting up from a deep cushioned window seat; a private karaoke room with spinning coloured lights — seated on a chair; a castle kitchen with a great hearth — trims the stems of a few loose flower stems on the worktable; the Changban Bridge memorial — holds her keepsake up beside her face; the deck of a tall wooden sailing ship at sea — standing; the stone stairway up to an old city gate tower — carries a camera by its grip at her side
